batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2013-2014-set3.pdf (4 pp.). ⚠ IDENTITY (prominent): the printed header (p.1) reads প্রাণিবিদ্যা বিভাগ (Department of Zoology), 'D2-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, সাভার', boxed 'Set CODE: 3', সময়ঃ ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. This is a D2-UNIT paper — a DIFFERENT paper from the D1 Botany paper that also prints Set CODE: 3 (extracted from file set2.pdf as ju-d-2013-2014-set3); the two must not be merged. The Drive listing label 'Set-3' matches the printed code numerically but does not distinguish the unit. Unlike the D1 compilations, this one prints NO ব্যাখ্যা — each question carries only a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key (Bangla letters ক-ঘ, mapped positionally to a-d). Subjects assigned per question by content (Bangla Q1-8; Zoology Q9-22, 30-60; English Q23-29); Zoology questions carry subject 'Biology' with topic 'Zoology' under the project JU D convention. 60 questions: 58 keyed, 2 KEYLESS (Q49, Q55 — the compilation prints no key box for them; handwritten reader ticks beside one option each were NOT treated as keys), 0 dual, 0 dispositions. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 23 of 60 questions verified. row 1: excluded (DIFFER) row 2: excluded (DIFFER) row 3: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 7: excluded (DIFFER) row 9: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 10: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 12: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 17: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 18: excluded (DIFFER) row 20: excluded (DIFFER) row 21: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 22: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 26: excluded (DIFFER) row 27: key conflict - Satt key (d) recorded, answer unverified row 28: key conflict - Satt key (d) recorded, answer unverified row 30: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 31: excluded (DIFFER) row 34: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 42: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 47: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 48: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 49: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 50: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 51: key conflict - Satt key (c) recorded, answer unverified row 52: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 53: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 55: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 56: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 57: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 58: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 59: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 60: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)
